_doc: Default gate thresholds. Copy to <workspace>/forge/gates.json to override per run. A required check that cannot run (tool missing, no data) FAILS - it never passes silently. Verdict is PASS only when every required check passes AND overall_score >= min_overall_score. A file named in $FORGE_GATES_OVERRIDE is merged last (used by CI).

coverage._doc: Gated on changed lines since state.base_ref (diff-cover) when measurable; otherwise on overall line coverage against min_line_pct.

security._license_doc: Trivy licence findings rated CRITICAL (forbidden, e.g. AGPL) or HIGH (restricted, e.g. GPL). Needs installed deps (node_modules / site-packages) to see transitive licences.

review._doc: Code review of the diff since state.base_ref: built-in /code-review + code-modernization architecture-critic (ADR drift). Evidence: forge/evidence/code-review.json

database._doc: applies only when state.db_migration is true (opt-in); otherwise n/a

commands._doc: Leave empty to auto-detect. Commands run with cwd = modernized code root. coverage_report = path (relative to that root) of lcov.info, cobertura/coverage.xml or jacoco.xml (these also enable changed-line coverage), or coverage-summary.json (Istanbul) / coverage.json (coverage.py) for overall only.
